evidenceBoundary: Playwright renders the Forms Builder and respondent page in Chromium on local Vite. The package test bridge supplies the app request contract and records exact calls while management, publication, public submission, response readback, CSV export, and deletion reach the isolated local Forms sidecar over HTTP. A local route fails one public submission so the UI can prove retained answers and retry; a fixture fails transient list reads. The 101-row pagination fixture seeds only the isolated SQLite database through FormsStore with valid synthetic answers and spaced rate-limit buckets, then browser page one and page two use the real sidecar cursor API. Screenshots are package-owned. This does not prove Core ExtensionHost delivery, a production node/hosted link, external provider behavior, native OS controls, or system clipboard integration.
